text: Appeal of Order to Comply (June 23, 2022) for 28 Crane Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the revised Order to Comply (August 3, 2022) for 28 Crane Avenue, Folder No. 22 128307 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to May 31, 2023.
